answer: A procurement agent buying ferrous scrap and copper for a beacon must not recover its wallet by collecting votes from strangers. The owner can precommit three guardian keys and require two signatures on a recovery message binding the account, replacement key, expiry, and unused nonce. Guardian changes require the existing owner or guardian threshold, never public headcount. Thousands of new aliases gain no recovery authority. This protects against Sybil recovery claims, but compromised or colluding guardians can still take over the account.
